lede: Dallas Cowboys carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#9 in EPA per play), while Washington Commanders owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#30 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Dallas Cowboys -3.6 with a fair total of 49.8 — inside a touchdown, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Washington Commanders pass offence vs Dallas Cowboys pass defence, which sits +0.216 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
